## Overview

Produces two small derived tables. (1) The estimated fraction of response-associated genes per stratum, π₁ = 1 − π₀, from the transcriptome-wide pseudobulk P values, by limma `propTrueNull` (local-FDR and histogram methods), together with the observed and expected number of genes at P < 0.01. (2) Whether low *FOLH1* or low AR activity in poor responders is lesion-wide or confined to a few regions: for patients with at least two ROIs in a stratum, AOI-level *FOLH1* and Hallmark androgen-response scores are summarised per patient as mean, minimum, maximum, s.d. and fraction of ROIs in the cohort's lowest quartile, and each summary is correlated with PSA change.

Part (1) reads the interim `C13_pseudobulk` limma results (comp_13, `filterByExpr` genes); the π₁ values in the final Supplementary Table 17 are recomputed from the LOQ-universe results by comp_47. Part (2) uses the LOQ gene universe and is the version reported.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Extended Data Fig. 4b (ROI-level summaries of *FOLH1* and Hallmark androgen response versus PSA change), via comp_28
- Supplementary Table 60 (via comp_29)
- Methods: Composition and heterogeneity sensitivity analyses (spatial heterogeneity)
- π₁ table: intermediate (used by comp_15; superseded in Supplementary Table 17 by comp_47)

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 13c_pi1_roi_heterogeneity`. Approximate runtime: about a minute.

**Inputs**

- `results/C13_pseudobulk/transcriptome_wide_limma_all_strata.csv`
- `data/phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs`
- `results/C1_clinical/patient_table.qs`
- `results/R1_loq/loq_gene_universes.qs`
- `data/reference/msigdb_gene_sets.rds`

**Outputs**

- `results/C13_pseudobulk/pi1_nonnull_fraction.csv`
- `results/C13_pseudobulk_LOQ/ROI_summary_heterogeneity_FOLH1_AR.csv`

**Depends on**: `comp_13_pseudobulk_primary`, `comp_16_loq_filter`, `comp_01_clinical`, `comp_00b_bone_cohort`

## Analysis

Header describing the two tables, which follow the bone-only cohort definition.

### π₁ and ROI-level heterogeneity
- π₁ per stratum from the pseudobulk limma P values (local-FDR and histogram estimators), with the observed versus expected number of genes at P < 0.01.
- For each compartment × timepoint stratum (control AOIs excluded), AOI-level TMM log-CPM on the ≥10% LOQ universe; *FOLH1* is taken directly and AR activity as the mean z-score of Hallmark androgen-response genes.
- Per patient with at least two AOIs: mean, minimum, maximum, s.d. and fraction of AOIs below the stratum's 25th percentile, each correlated with maximal PSA change (Spearman).

```{r comp-13c-pi1-roi-heterogeneity-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE -- two small derived tables previously produced by one-off code (Oct 2026),
## now scripted so that they follow the PRINCE_BONE_ONLY switch:
##  (1) C13_pseudobulk/pi1_nonnull_fraction.csv: non-null fraction (pi1) per stratum of the
##      transcriptome-wide pseudobulk limma P values
##  (2) C13_pseudobulk_LOQ/ROI_summary_heterogeneity_FOLH1_AR.csv: ROI-level FOLH1 / Hallmark AR
##      summaries (mean, min, max, sd, fraction in cohort lowest quartile) vs PSA change,
##      patients with >= 2 ROIs
## ============================================================================
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({ library(SummarizedExperiment); library(edgeR); library(limma); library(dplyr) })

## (1) pi1
t <- read.csv(file.path(COMP_DIR, "C13_pseudobulk", "transcriptome_wide_limma_all_strata.csv"))
r <- t %>% group_by(stratum) %>% summarise(pi1_lfdr = 1 - propTrueNull(P.Value, method = "lfdr"),
  pi1_hist = 1 - propTrueNull(P.Value, method = "hist"), n_p01 = sum(P.Value < 0.01), exp_p01 = round(0.01 * n()))
print(as.data.frame(r), digits = 2)
write.csv(r, file.path(COMP_DIR, "C13_pseudobulk", "pi1_nonnull_fraction.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

## (2) ROI-level heterogeneity
se <- qs::qread(file.path(PRINCE_DIR, "phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs")); cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
pt <- qs::qread(out_path("C1_clinical", "patient_table.qs"))
uni <- qs::qread(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "loq_gene_universes.qs"))$universes
msig <- readRDS(file.path(PMCC_DIR, "msigdb_gene_sets.rds"))
code <- c("CD45+" = "CD45", "PSMA+" = "PSMA", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCKPSMA"); out <- list()
for (sg in names(code)) for (tp in c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")) {
  idx <- which(cd$segment_name == sg & cd$timepoint == tp & cd$response_group_neat != "Control"); d <- cd[idx, ]
  g <- uni[[paste0(code[sg], "__", tp)]]$g10
  lc <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(assay(se, "all_count")[g, idx])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
  z <- t(scale(t(lc))); ar <- colMeans(z[intersect(msig$H$HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE, rownames(z)), ])
  for (f in c("FOLH1", "AR_Hallmark")) {
    v <- if (f == "FOLH1") lc["FOLH1", ] else ar; q25 <- quantile(v, 0.25)
    s <- data.frame(subject_id = d$subject_id, v = v) %>% group_by(subject_id) %>% filter(n() >= 2) %>%
      summarise(n_roi = n(), mean = mean(v), min = min(v), max = max(v), sd = sd(v), frac_low = mean(v < q25), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(pt, by = "subject_id")
    for (st in c("mean", "min", "max", "sd", "frac_low")) {
      ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(s[[st]], s$max_psa_change, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
      out[[paste(sg, tp, f, st)]] <- data.frame(segment = sg, timepoint = tp, feature = f, summary = st, n = nrow(s),
        med_roi = median(s$n_roi), rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value) }
  }
}
res <- bind_rows(out)
write.csv(res, file.path(COMP_DIR, "C13_pseudobulk_LOQ", "ROI_summary_heterogeneity_FOLH1_AR.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("13c complete\n")
```
